unit: one frozen boundary x condition x measured continuation
evaluation_rule: Scores and deltas are comparable only within one non-null basis_id. Null fields require an explicit missingness reason. closure_readiness is separate from quality_class.
identity_rule: The tuple repository_id, commit, run_id, cell_id, condition is canonical. Experiment names alone are not episode identities.
causal_rule: Rows retain the source study's causal scope. Cross-study summaries are descriptive and must not be read as causal pooling.
